//: Without this file Vercel found no framework at the repository root and served the root itself as static files. That published the entire repo: supabase/schema.sql, all of server/, all of app/src, and app/db.js were all fetchable over HTTPS. Building app/ and serving only app/dist means nothing but the compiled site is reachable.

rewrites.//: React Navigation drives real URLs once a linking config exists, but index.html is the only HTML file on disk. Without this, a refresh or a shared deep link 404s. Vercel serves files that exist before applying rewrites, so the bundle and assets are unaffected. /api is excluded deliberately: catching it here would hand API calls a page of HTML instead of an honest 404, and it is where a real backend or proxy would be mounted.

headers.//: app/public/.htaccess carries these for Apache, which Vercel ignores entirely — they have to be restated here or the deployed site ships with no security headers at all.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://maps.googleapis.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://maps.googleapis.com https://maps.gstatic.com https://*.googleapis.com https://*.ggpht.com; connect-src 'self' https://*.supabase.co wss://*.supabase.co https://maps.googleapis.com; frame-ancestors 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'

headers.//: Bundle filenames are content-hashed, so they are immutable. index.html must not be cached or a deploy does not take effect.
